title: Back to the same courtyard
odia: ଆରେ ଢମଣା , ବୁଲି ବୁଲିକରି ସେଇ ଅଗଣା ।
literal_meaning: Hey, dhamana, after all that wandering, you are back in the same courtyard.
explanation: A wandering journey ends where it began. In conversation, the image can describe repeated detours that bring no change, or someone returning to a familiar place after trying alternatives. The tone may be teasing or critical, depending on the situation.
meaning_odia: ବହୁତ ଘୂରିବୁଲି ଶେଷରେ ପୁଣି ସେହି ଅଗଣାକୁ ଫେରିଆସିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା। ଅନେକ ଚେଷ୍ଟା ବା ବୁଲାଣି ପରେ ଫଳରେ ବିଶେଷ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ନହେଲେ କଥାଟି ଖାପ ଖାଏ। ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଅନୁସାରେ ଏଥିରେ ବିଫଳ ଚେଷ୍ଟାର ହାସ୍ୟ ଥାଇପାରେ, କିମ୍ବା ପରିଚିତ ଜାଗାକୁ ଫେରିବାର ଭାବ।
usage_example: After considering several meeting places, the group chooses its usual courtyard again. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The creature-name dhamana is retained without assigning a precise species. The courtyard supplies the image of return; no belief about animal behaviour or local origin is established.
